description: This file defines an interface for a device grain in Orleans, specifying methods for retrieving serial numbers and setting owner information.

classes.name: IDeviceGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface for device-related operations, including retrieving serial number and setting owner.

methods.name: GetSerialNumber
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the serial number of the device.

methods.name: SetOwner
methods.description: Associates the device with a customer grain asynchronously.
